query:
INSERT INTO acc_entitlements (citizen_id, has_entitlement, type, weekly_amount, remaining_weeks)
           VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5)
           ON CONFLICT (citizen_id) DO UPDATE SET
              has_entitlement = EXCLUDED.has_entitlement,
              type = EXCLUDED.type,
              weekly_amount = EXCLUDED.weekly_amount,
              remaining_weeks = EXCLUDED.remaining_weeks
           RETURNING (xmax = 0) AS inserted
